context_for_next_testing_agent: Real-time notification system fully working. Notification endpoints: vendor (/api/notifications/vendor/*) and admin (/api/notifications/admin/*). WebSocket at /api/ws/notifications?token=xxx&role=vendor|admin. Credit add triggers notification via notify_credits_added(). Sound uses Web Audio API with 5s cooldown. Mute toggle saves to localStorage. Razorpay and Instagram Auto-DMs are MOCKED.
